rites.name: Surataloma
rites.text: Surataloma is the concept of the rising hush that gathers before roots take hold in Silara, a quiet pressure felt in the first groves. It is said to be the moment the land decides it will remain, and kingdoms grow in its wake.

rites.name: Osusaraleno
rites.text: Osusaraleno is the still hush of Silara's Seeding, when the makers press the Weave into the dark soil of the world and the sleeping powers of the realm lie folded like unopened buds. It is not a being but a condition of potential, a moment when everything that will someday burn is only a whisper in the root.

rites.name: Khaktar
rites.text: Khaktar is the concept of the sworn bargain in Silara's Arcane Realm, the principle that a promise bound by root and star holds even as worlds break apart. It is said to have stood between the Shards during the Sundering, keeping the groves' oaths intact while the first sovereign's kingdoms rose from the broken ground.

rites.name: Nernor
rites.text: A craft that binds lasting boons into a traveler's garments, so each woven charm adds its own strength. The boons may pile up, and the garment's appearance is separate from the power it holds.

rites.name: Croduron
rites.text: Croduron is a concept in Silara's Arcane Realm, shaped during the Walled Age as holding walls, orders and first crossings took form. It stands as an idea of endurance and the bond between stone and grove, carried through the reign of the first sovereign. Its power is measured in the quiet strength of its walls rather than in sudden ruin.

rites.name: Kaikun
rites.text: Kaikun is a concept woven into Silara during the Age of the first sovereign, when groves were still growing into kingdoms. It is held in the Library of the Three Futures, where every ending branches and is shelved, and it is said to name the moment a branch is chosen.
